title: Usuku olujwayelekile
description: Ten short, simple stories about everyday life: meals at home, school, sport, the police, health, family, work and the town.

lessons.title: Ukudla ekhaya
lessons.summary: Mondli cooks at home for his grown son Nkosinathi; they eat together, Nkosinathi asks for water, then goes out to work.
lessons.text:
UMondli uyindoda endala. Uhlala ekhaya nendodana yakhe. Igama lendodana yakhe nguNkosinathi. Ikhaya lakhe lincane, kodwa lihle.

Ngolunye usuku uMondli wenza ukudla. Bese uthi: "Nkosinathi, ukudla kukhona lapha!"

UNkosinathi uyeza. Indoda nendodana bahlala phansi, bese bayadla. Ukudla kwekhaya kuhle kakhulu.

UNkosinathi uthi: "Baba, ngicela amanzi." UMondli uthatha amanzi, uwanika uNkosinathi. UNkosinathi uthi: "Amanzi mahle. Ngicela amanye amanzi futhi."

Ngemuva kokudla uNkosinathi uthi: "Manje kumele ngiphume. Ngiya emsebenzini."

UMondli uthi: "Hamba kahle, ndodana yami. Lapha ekhaya kuzoba nokudla njalo."

UNkosinathi uyaphuma. Uphuma ekhaya, bese uhamba ngendlela. Indoda ibheka ngaphandle. Ithi: "Indodana yami yindoda manje. Kodwa uma ifika lapha, sizodla kanye futhi."

Imibuzo:
UMondli uhlala ekhaya nendodana yakhe na?
Kunjalo, uhlala ekhaya noNkosinathi.
UNkosinathi ucela amanzi na?
Kunjalo, ucela amanzi.
UNkosinathi uyaphi ngemuva kokudla?
Uya emsebenzini.
UMondli uphuma ekhaya na?
Cha, uNkosinathi uyaphuma. UMondli uhlala ekhaya.

lessons.title: Umfundi omusha
lessons.summary: Ntokozo, a new pupil from Soweto, does not understand a word in her book; the teacher explains it, she repeats it and writes it down.
lessons.text:
UNtokozo ungumfundi omusha. Usuka eSoweto, kodwa manje uhlala eThekwini. Isikole sakhe sisha futhi, sikhulu kakhulu. Kunabafundi abaningi lapho.

Esikoleni abafundi bakhuluma ulimi olusha kuNtokozo. UNtokozo ufuna ukufunda ulimi olusha kahle.

Ngolunye usuku uthisha unika abafundi incwadi. Uthi: "Fundani le ncwadi."

UNtokozo uyafunda. Kodwa akaqondi amanye amazwi. Uthi kuthisha: "Angiqondi izwi leli."

Uthisha uyachaza. Uchaza izwi kahle ngamanye amazwi. Bese uthi: "Phinda izwi leli, Ntokozo."

UNtokozo uphinda izwi. Uliphinda futhi. Manje uyaqonda.

Uthisha uthi: "Kuhle! Manje bhala izwi leli encwadini yakho."

UNtokozo ubhala izwi encwadini. Ubhala namanye amazwi amasha. Uthisha uchaza amazwi onke.

Ekhaya uNtokozo ufunda incwadi futhi. Ubhala amazwi amasha njalo. Uthi: "Ngiyaqonda amazwi amaningi manje. Ngizofunda njalo ukuze ngiqonde ulimi lonke."

Imibuzo:
UNtokozo ungumfundi omusha na?
Kunjalo, ungumfundi omusha esikoleni.
UNtokozo uyaliqonda izwi ekuqaleni na?
Cha, akaliqondi. Uthisha uyalichaza.
UNtokozo ubhala izwi encwadini yakhe na?
Kunjalo, ulibhala encwadini yakhe.
UNtokozo ufunda incwadi ekhaya na?
Kunjalo, uyifunda ekhaya futhi.

lessons.title: Umdlalo omkhulu
lessons.summary: Lwandiso counts only three players up front and needs four; Thamsanqa arrives, is chosen, plays well and his team wins.
lessons.text:
UThamsanqa uthanda ukudlala. Ungumdlali weqembu lesikole sakhe. Uthanda iqembu lakhe kakhulu.

Ngolunye usuku iqembu linomdlalo omkhulu. Abantu abaningi beza emdlalweni.

ULwandiso ukhetha abadlali. Uyababala abadlali: "Munye, babili, bathathu." Uthi: "Ngidinga abadlali abane phambili. Kodwa kukhona abathathu nje."

Bese uThamsanqa uyafika. ULwandiso uthi: "Thamsanqa, ngikhetha wena! Uzodlala phambili."

Umdlalo uyaqala. UThamsanqa udlala phambili nabanye abadlali abathathu. Ushaya ibhola kahle. Ulishaya futhi.

Abantu bathi: "UThamsanqa ungumdlali omuhle!" Bayamthanda kakhulu.

Ngemuva komdlalo uLwandiso uyawabala amagoli. Iqembu likaThamsanqa lishaye amagoli amane. Elinye iqembu lishaye amathathu.

ULwandiso uthi: "Ngikhethe kahle. Thamsanqa, uzodlala phambili njalo. Iqembu lethu liyakuthanda."

UThamsanqa uthi: "Nami ngiyalithanda iqembu. Ngizodlala kahle kuyo yonke imidlalo."

Imibuzo:
UThamsanqa uthanda ukudlala na?
Kunjalo, uthanda ukudlala kakhulu.
ULwandiso udinga abadlali abane phambili na?
Kunjalo, udinga abadlali abane.
ULwandiso ukhetha uThamsanqa na?
Kunjalo, ukhetha uThamsanqa.
Iqembu likaThamsanqa lishaye amagoli amane na?
Kunjalo, lishaye amagoli amane.

lessons.title: Imoto kaNomalanga
lessons.summary: Nomalanga's new car is gone; she tells a police officer, he searches, the car is found and the man who took it is arrested.
lessons.text:
UNomalanga unemoto enhle kakhulu. Uyithanda kakhulu imoto yakhe.

Ngolunye usuku uNomalanga uphuma endlini. Ubheka imoto yakhe ngaphandle. Imoto ayikho!

UNomalanga uya emaphoyiseni. Utshela iphoyisa indaba yakhe. Uthi: "Imoto yami ayikho. Ngiyayidinga ngenxa yomsebenzi wami."

Iphoyisa lithi: "Ngitshele yonke indaba. Ngizohlola."

UNomalanga utshela iphoyisa indaba yonke. Iphoyisa liyahlola. Lihlola indawo kaNomalanga, bese lihlola nezinye izindawo.

Ngemuva kwesikhathi imoto iyatholakala. Itholakala endaweni encane ngaphandle kwaseThekwini.

Kukhona indoda emotweni. Iphoyisa lithi: "Lowo muntu uthathe imoto kaNomalanga." Iphoyisa liyambamba lowo muntu.

Lowo muntu unecala. Icala lakhe likhulu ngenxa yokuthi uthathe imoto kaNomalanga.

Iphoyisa litshela uNomalanga: "Imoto yakho ikhona. Lowo muntu unecala, futhi simbambile."

UNomalanga uthi: "Ngiyabonga kakhulu!" Uthatha imoto yakhe, uhamba ekhaya.

Imibuzo:
UNomalanga unemoto enhle na?
Kunjalo, unemoto enhle kakhulu.
UNomalanga utshela iphoyisa indaba yakhe na?
Kunjalo, ulitshela indaba yakhe.
Imoto iyatholakala na?
Kunjalo, itholakala endaweni encane.
Iphoyisa liyambamba lowo muntu na?
Kunjalo, liyambamba. Lowo muntu unecala.

lessons.title: Impilo kaNomthandazo
lessons.summary: Old Nomthandazo feels weak; her son takes her hand and they walk down the road in the fresh air every day until she is well again.
lessons.text:
UNomthandazo ungumuntu omdala. Uhlala eMlazi nendodana yakhe, uMthokozisi.

Ngolunye usuku uNomthandazo akaphili kahle. Umzimba wakhe awunawo amandla. Isimo sakhe sibi. Uthi: "Kubi kakhulu. Umzimba wami awusebenzi kahle."

UMthokozisi uthi: "Mama, kumele uphume. Umoya omuhle uzokusiza."

UNomthandazo uthatha isandla sendodana yakhe. Baphuma endlini. Behla ngendlela kancane. UMthokozisi ubamba isandla sakhe kahle.

Nsuku zonke uNomthandazo uyaphuma. Wehla ngendlela, uthola umoya omuhle. Bese uhamba ekhaya.

Ngemuva kwesikhathi kuyabonakala ukuthi isimo sakhe singcono. Umzimba wakhe unamandla futhi.

UNomthandazo uthi: "Manje ngiphila kahle. Umzimba wami ungcono kakhulu. Isimo esibi asikho."

UMthokozisi uthi: "Kuyabonakala, mama. Impilo yakho ingcono. Umoya omuhle ukusizile."

UNomthandazo uthi: "Impilo yinto enhle. Ngizophuma njalo, ngehle ngendlela."

Imibuzo:
UNomthandazo uyaphila kahle ekuqaleni na?
Cha, isimo sakhe sibi.
UNomthandazo uthatha isandla sendodana yakhe na?
Kunjalo, uthatha isandla sikaMthokozisi.
UNomthandazo wehla ngendlela nsuku zonke na?
Kunjalo, wehla ngendlela, uthola umoya omuhle.
Isimo sakhe singcono ngemuva kwesikhathi na?
Kunjalo, impilo yakhe ingcono.

lessons.title: Ingane kaNosihle
lessons.summary: Bonginkosi works in Johannesburg; while he is away his wife Nosihle gives birth to a son, and he comes home to see the baby grow.
lessons.text:
UNosihle noBonginkosi bangumndeni omncane. Umndeni wabo uhlala eMgungundlovu. UBonginkosi usebenza eGoli. Ubuya ekhaya kanye ngenyanga.

Kulo nyaka uNosihle uzozala ingane. Ngaphambi kokuthi uBonginkosi abuye, uNosihle uzala indodana.

UBonginkosi useGoli. Ucabanga ngomndeni wakhe njalo. Uthi: "Ngabe ingane iyaphila? Ngabe uNosihle uyaphila?"

Ngemuva kwesonto uBonginkosi uyabuya. Ufika ekhaya, ubona indodana yakhe. Uthi: "Phela, yinhle kakhulu! Izokhula ibe yindoda enkulu."

UBonginkosi uhlala ekhaya isonto lonke. Umndeni wonke uhlala ndawonye.

Ngemuva kwesonto kumele aye eGoli futhi. Ucabanga ngengane yakhe nsuku zonke. Uthi: "Inyanga iyaphela. Ngizobuya ngaphambi kokuthi inyanga iphele."

UBonginkosi ubuya ekhaya njalo ngenyanga. Ingane iyakhula. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu ingane inkulu kakhulu.

UNosihle uthi: "Phela, ingane yethu ikhula kahle."

Imibuzo:
UBonginkosi usebenza eGoli na?
Kunjalo, usebenza eGoli.
UNosihle uzala indodana na?
Kunjalo, uzala indodana.
UBonginkosi ubuya ekhaya ngemuva kwesonto na?
Kunjalo, ubuya ngemuva kwesonto.
Ingane iyakhula na?
Kunjalo, ikhula kahle.

lessons.title: Inhlangano kaThobeka
lessons.summary: Thobeka leads a small group making household goods in Pietermaritzburg; they bring in more people, build a bigger workroom and the group grows.
lessons.text:
UThobeka uhola inhlangano encane eMgungundlovu. Inhlangano yakhe ikhiqiza izinto zasekhaya. Abantu abane basebenza lapho.

Ekuqaleni inhlangano incane kakhulu. Ikhiqiza izinto ezimbili nje ngosuku.

UThobeka uthi: "Imikhiqizo yethu mihle. Izinga lemikhiqizo yethu lihle. Kodwa kumele inhlangano ithuthuke."

UThobeka uhlanganisa abantu abaningi bomphakathi. Bonke basebenza kanye. UThobeka uyabahola kahle.

Abantu benhlangano bakha indlu enkulu yomsebenzi. Umsebenzi wokwakha uthatha izinyanga ezimbili. Bakha indlu enhle kakhulu.

Manje inhlangano iyathuthuka. Ikhiqiza izinto eziningi. Abantu bakhipha imikhiqizo endlini, bayibeka ngaphandle ukuze abantu bayibone. Bakhipha imikhiqizo emihle nsuku zonke.

UThobeka uhlola izinga lemikhiqizo njalo. Uthi: "Izinga lethu lihle. Kumele siqhubeke nomsebenzi wethu."

Inhlangano iyaqhubeka. Iqhubeka nokukhiqiza imikhiqizo emihle. UThobeka uhlanganisa nabanye abantu bomphakathi, futhi uqhubeka nokuhola inhlangano.

Imibuzo:
UThobeka uhola inhlangano na?
Kunjalo, uhola inhlangano encane.
Inhlangano ikhiqiza izinto zasekhaya na?
Kunjalo, ikhiqiza izinto zasekhaya.
Abantu benhlangano bakha indlu enkulu na?
Kunjalo, bakha indlu enkulu yomsebenzi.
Inhlangano iyathuthuka na?
Kunjalo, iyathuthuka.

lessons.title: Inkinga yamanzi
lessons.summary: Chief Mbuso's people have no water; he plans the work, talks to the government, and a big water point is built.
lessons.text:
UMbuso uyinkosi yesizwe esincane. Isizwe sakhe sinenkinga enkulu: akukho amanzi. Abantu bahamba kakhulu ukuze bathole amanzi.

Abantu batshela inkosi ngodaba lwamanzi. Bathi: "Nkosi, amanzi ayisidingo sethu esikhulu."

Inkosi ithi: "Udaba lolu lukhulu. Ngizokhuluma nohulumeni."

Inkosi ihlela uhlelo. Ihlela nomsebenzi wabantu besizwe. Bese iya kuhulumeni. Ithi: "Isizwe sami sinenkinga. Isidingo sethu ngamanzi."

Uhulumeni uthi: "Siyaqonda udaba lwenu. Sizoninika ithuba." Uhulumeni uveza uhlelo lwamanzi. Uveza nendawo enkulu yamanzi.

Inkosi iqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bonke bazi ngohlelo. Ithi: "Leli yithuba elihle. Kumele silisebenzise."

Abantu besizwe basebenza kanye nohulumeni. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezine kukhona amanzi. Inkosi iqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi.

Inkinga iphelile. Isizwe sinamanzi manje. Inkosi ithi: "Udaba lolu luphelile kahle. Isizwe sethu sinethuba elisha manje."

Imibuzo:
Isizwe sinenkinga yamanzi na?
Kunjalo, akukho amanzi.
Inkosi ikhuluma nohulumeni na?
Kunjalo, ikhuluma nohulumeni ngodaba lwamanzi.
Uhulumeni unika isizwe ithuba na?
Kunjalo, uhulumeni unika isizwe ithuba.
Inkinga iphelile na?
Kunjalo, isizwe sinamanzi manje.

lessons.title: Uhlobo olusha lokudla
lessons.summary: Lindokuhle has only a little money; at a food stall she asks about a new kind of food, buys a part of it and water, and carries them home.
lessons.text:
ULindokuhle uphuma ekhaya ukuze athole ukudla. Unemali encane kuphela.

Ufika endaweni enokudla okuningi. Kukhona umuntu onezinto eziningi phezu kwetafula. Kukhona namanzi.

ULindokuhle ubheka lezi zinto ezinhle. Uthi: "Yini le?"

Umuntu uthi: "Lokhu wuhlobo olusha lokudla. Uhlobo lolu luhle kakhulu."

ULindokuhle uthi: "Lezi zinto zibiza imali eningi na? Nginemali encane kuphela."

Umuntu uthi: "Cha, zibiza imali encane. Amanzi la nawo abiza imali encane."

ULindokuhle uthi: "Ngicela ingxenye yalokhu kudla. Angifuni konke, ngifuna ingxenye kuphela. Phezu kwalokho, ngicela namanzi la."

Umuntu umnika ingxenye yokudla namanzi. ULindokuhle umnika imali.

ULindokuhle uphatha ukudla namanzi ngezandla zakhe. Uhamba ekhaya. Uphethe ukudla kahle.

Ekhaya umndeni wakhe uthi: "Yini le?" ULindokuhle uthi: "Wuhlobo olusha lokudla. Kuhle kakhulu!"

Imibuzo:
ULindokuhle unemali eningi na?
Cha, unemali encane kuphela.
Izinto zikhona phezu kwetafula na?
Kunjalo, zikhona phezu kwetafula.
Lezi zinto zibiza imali eningi na?
Cha, zibiza imali encane.
ULindokuhle uthatha ingxenye yokudla na?
Kunjalo, uthatha ingxenye yokudla namanzi.

lessons.title: UZola eThekwini
lessons.summary: Zola has lived alone in Durban since last year and knows the city; she shows two lost people the way to a big school.
lessons.text:
UZola uhlala yedwa eThekwini. Uhlala lapha kusukela ngonyaka odlule. Usuka endaweni encane, kodwa manje unolwazi oluningi ngeThekwini.

Ngolunye usuku uZola uhamba ngendlela. Ubona abantu ababili. Labo bantu abanalo ulwazi ngendawo.

Labo bantu bathi: "Sifuna indlela eya esikoleni esikhulu. Ngeke siyithole sodwa."

UZola uthi: "Ngiyayazi indlela. Ngakho, ngizonisiza."

UZola uhamba nabo. Badlula ezindlini eziningi. Badlula nasemsebenzini kaZola.

UZola uthi: "Isikole sikhona phambili. Sona sikhulu kakhulu. Ngeke nisidlule."

Labo bantu bafika esikoleni. Bathi: "Isikole yisona lesi!" Bathi kuZola: "Unolwazi oluningi. Ngenxa yakho, sifikile."

UZola uthi: "Kusukela ngafika eThekwini, ngifunde izinto eziningi. Ulwazi lwami lukhulu manje. Ngakho, ngiyakwazi ukusiza abantu."

UZola uhamba ekhaya yedwa. Uthi: "Namuhla ngisize abantu. Kuhle kakhulu."

Imibuzo:
UZola uhlala yedwa eThekwini na?
Kunjalo, uhlala yedwa.
UZola uhlala eThekwini kusukela nini?
Kusukela ngonyaka odlule.
Labo bantu banolwazi ngendawo na?
Cha, abanalo ulwazi.
UZola uyabasiza labo bantu na?
Kunjalo, uyabasiza ngoba unolwazi.
